one_sentence_takeaway: The headline forecasting result: deterministic NGRC on the full 64D field predicts ~15x further than any other model, and is the only one not bounded by a learned representation. The stable-ridge correction LOWERED it from 419.2.
The same deterministic method in latent-8 coordinates collapses from 324.0 to 9.8 on test - the sharpest evidence that latent-space forecasting is bounded by the representation, not the forecaster.
Stochastic RC on the full field; its published 49.6 was a lucky seed and the seed-robust median is 24.4.
Stochastic RC in latent-8; published 42.4 corrected to a 15-seed median of 20.0.
Physics-enforced RC on the full field; the widest seed lottery in the study (luckiest seed 64.3 vs median 25.6).
Physics-enforced RC in latent-8; its published candidate ranked dead last of its own top ten after reranking.

PINN on the full field with a genuinely active physics term; selected on validation evidence alone (15-seed median 19.8) and locked before test access, its single test evaluation gave 7.3 - far below validation, reported as found.
PINN in latent-8; the largest correction in the study (26.7 -> 10.4, 2.57x) and the clearest case that a search score is not a metric.
